evidence:
This is a fresh independent exact-proposal review of ASTIS-REPAIR-ANDI-GDV-NONNEGATIVE-STEP. Candidate evidence was limited to runs/semantic-roundtrip/andi-opt-gd-value/repair-reviewer.json. I did not read the registry or prior verdict/source-review files and did not reuse the Theorem 3.3 decision. I am neither andi-gdv-worker nor value_blind and did not author the repair. I decoded reference_or_counterexample, checked it is a string containing valid sorted-key JSON, and inspected each of its three counterexamples.

Primary-source check: I directly reopened https://arxiv.org/html/2605.07006v1 and inspected Section 3, Lemma 3.1, Theorem 3.4 and remark (3.3). The section assumes C² Euclidean functions. Lemma 3.1 and Theorem 3.4 print h≤1/β. Remark (3.3) explicitly replaces the minimizer with any z. Thus arbitrary-comparator scope is source-backed, rather than a new hypothesis or theorem strengthening silently introduced by this repair.

Descent counterexample: for f(t)=t²/2, β=1, h=−1, x=1, the derivative is t and T(1)=2. The actual increment is 2−1/2=3/2; the printed upper bound is 1/2. All regularity and positive reciprocal requirements hold, and h≤1/β. In fact for every h<0 with x=1 the increment is −h+h²/2, exceeding −h/2 by (h²−h)/2>0. This failure is mathematical and not specific to a Lean API or proof route.

Comparator-energy counterexample: the same quadratic is α-strongly convex for α=1/2 as well as β-smooth for β=1; a valid modulus need not be the largest possible one. Its Hessian 1 lies above 1/2 and at the smoothness bound. Set h=−1,x=0,z=1. Then T(0)=0, the left side is 1+2(−1)(−1/2)=2, and the right side is (1+1/2)·1=3/2. The signed gap is −1/2; no assumption in the source arbitrary-comparator statement excludes it. More generally this choice of f,α,β,x,z gives LHS=1−h, RHS=1−h/2, so every h<0 fails. Here z=1 is not a minimizer. This is evidence for necessity in (3.3), not a claim that this example falsifies the minimizer-only specialization (3.1).

Weighted diagnostic also checks exactly: with x₀=0,z=1,N=2 all actual iterates are 0, q=3/2, S₂=1+q=5/2, and the final gap is −1/2. Hence 2hS₂ times the gap is 5/2, whereas q²‖x₀−z‖²=9/4. The example concerns only the stated arbitrary-comparator extension; it establishes neither a failure of the minimizer weighted statement nor a repair of the inverse-power formula. It is valid supplementary obstruction evidence and is not needed for accepting the narrower one-step repair.

Sufficiency verified directly with the exact constants: let g=∇f(x), s=x−hg, v=x−z. The quadratic upper model gives f(s)−f(x)≤(−h+βh²/2)‖g‖². Under β>0 and 0≤h≤1/β, βh²≤h and thus f(s)−f(x)≤−h‖g‖²/2. This descent argument needs no convexity hypothesis at all; adding α-convexity is unnecessary for Lemma 3.1 itself. For the energy conclusion, the source lower-support bound is f(z)≥f(x)−⟨g,v⟩+(α/2)‖v‖². Adding the descent bound to its rearrangement gives f(s)−f(z)≤⟨g,v⟩−(α/2)‖v‖²−(h/2)‖g‖². Multiplication by 2h≥0 and addition of ‖v−hg‖²=‖v‖²−2h⟨g,v⟩+h²‖g‖² cancels both gradient terms and yields exactly (1−αh)‖v‖². No sign restriction on f(s)−f(z), no minimizer and no division by h enter. Substituting a supplied minimizer for z recovers (3.1).

Minimality: h=0 yields T=identity, the descent inequality 0≤0, and the energy equality ‖x−z‖²≤‖x−z‖². Excluding that endpoint by h>0 would be unnecessary. Every negative step is ruled out for the unchanged class of smooth objectives by the descent example and for the unchanged arbitrary-comparator class by the energy example. The existing upper endpoint 1/β is retained. Thus adding only h≥0 is minimal as a restriction on the universal step interval for the combined descent/arbitrary-comparator assertions. No additional smoothness, stronger curvature or minimizer assumption is warranted. Necessity is established for these assertions, without asserting that each specialized minimizer statement individually fails at negative h.

Preserved source domain and scope: β>0 remains the ordinary reciprocal domain; βh≤1 is equivalent to h≤1/β only there. The proposed C² Euclidean formulation retains source curvature conventions. The local C¹ Hilbert-space setting and signed α/β parameters are distinct generalizations, not accepted as source repairs. No new αh≤1 restriction is needed for the one-step algebra. In the usual nonnegative compatible source setting it follows from α≤β and the chosen step, but any weighted recurrence needs its own coefficient-domain accounting. The repair does not divide by h, 1−αh or a geometric sum and does not interpret the inverse-power rate at h=0, q=0, q=1 or N=0. Such singular endpoints and limiting normalized rates remain outside this decision.

Decision: accept this exact h≥0 assumption-addition overlay for Lemma 3.1 and the one-step (3.1)/(3.3) assertions. The source remains pinned separately; this is not blanket acceptance of Theorem 3.4 including its inverse-power rate or of the full candidate publication. The reconstruction presents the two conclusions jointly under the energy theorem assumptions; the descent lemma itself should continue to retain its original smoothness-only objective assumption, as the proposed change adds only a step restriction.
